course.title: Health and Safety in Construction
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A workman was employed in a building construction. project on a monthly (09) wage of Taka 20,000. While working helmet with an accident and permanent total disabled on March, 2011. His date of birth is April 21, 1971. Calculate the amount of compensation payable to his dependent. Consider the relevant factor of age 40 is 184.17.
